stem: A technician photographs a symptom for a crop record. Which practice makes the image most useful?
choices: Include enough context to identify location and scale, then add a closer view of the symptom when appropriate
Use only a heavily filtered close-up with no location information
Photograph a healthy plant from another room instead
Crop out all surrounding tissue so distribution cannot be seen
rationale: Useful documentation combines context with detail so later reviewers can interpret location, scale, and visible features.
